categories.remarks:
All fees displayed are exclusive of 6% SST.
Effective 1 September 2025, a 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST) will be imposed on education-related fees for non-Malaysian citizens, as mandated by the Royal Malaysian Customs Department.

Notes:
- This Fee Structure is binding and applicable to the student upon registration.
- All fees are payable to Asia Metropolitan University.
- Fees payable are subject to Sales and Services Tax (SST) charges, where applicable.
- Application Fee, Student Processing Fee, Registration Fee, Visa Application Fee and Administrative Fee are strictly non-refundable.
- All students must pay their semester fees in full within thirty (30) days from the date of invoice.
- The University reserves the right to suspend studies for students with outstanding fees.
- AMU Bundle Programme Scholarship includes credit transfer fee adjustment. Students in this programme are not eligible for additional discounts, rebates, or scholarships at Diploma level.
- Commitment Fees are set by the Student Recruitment Department and will be offset against the Tuition Fee upon successful registration, where applicable.
- Students must refer to the 'Malaysian Student Financial Policy Handbook' for most up-to-date Terms & Conditions which are binding.
- The information provided in this document is correct at the time of publication, and the University reserves the right to make future amendments when deemed necessary.
- The fee does not include the cost for Deferment, Re-sit/Repeat Fee Examinations, Examination Fee, or any costs arising from extended study duration due to unsatisfactory academic performance.
- The University reserves the right to demand all outstanding fees for both previous and current semesters from the student and/or guarantor if the student withdraws or leaves before completing the programme.
- Students who withdraw from the programme after twenty-one (21) working days after the semester begins will not be eligible for a refund. Full semester fee shall be due and payable.
